thoughts.question: Life is low: keep fighting, drink, run, portal or leave the game?
thoughts.ifNothing: If you do nothing: no rule is made and the hero keeps asking.
thoughts.rule: Rule applies when: in act 1, no champion bonus, on Normal, life 26 to 49%, hardcore hero, a healing potion at hand, with potions and a portal.
thoughts.context: in act 1, no champion bonus, on Normal, life 26 to 49%, hardcore hero, a healing potion at hand, with potions and a portal
